broad_self_distillation_used.principle: False because Exp 5227 performs verified typed-memory operations only, with no model training.

consumer_ready_path.principle: Path to the ARC rubric setup file for Exp 5228.

continuous_self_learning_task.principle: This field proves the milestone includes the required continuous self-learning experiment.

honest_verdict.principle: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ and state whether typed memory is consumer-ready.
honest_verdict.value: complete: typed memory consumer-ready for exp5228 with 4 heads, promotions_2_rollbacks_4, retention_passed_True, verified_typed_memory_no_model_training

memory_entries_written.principle: Count of schema-valid typed memory entries written to the durable ledger.

promotions.principle: Entries reusable by future controllers because they cite artifact evidence.

retention_check_passed.principle: True only when critical older retirements are returned by relevance queries.

rollbacks.principle: Entries blocked, quarantined, or retired with explicit invalidating evidence.

tests_run.principle: List of verification commands with pass/fail status.

typed_memory_heads.principle: List of typed memory heads available for verifier and ARC consumers.
